units.source_text: 年终岁初，是温泉的旺季。

en.t: The end of the year and the beginning of the new one are the busy season for hot springs.

units.source_text: 电车通到伊东市，大街小巷都披上了庆贺的新装，显出一派繁荣景象。

en.t: The train ran as far as Ito City, and every main street and side lane had put on festive decorations, presenting a scene of prosperity.

units.source_text: 我同被“禁闭”的棋手们一起幽居在旅馆的房间里。

en.t: I secluded myself in a room at the inn together with the go players who had been kept in confinement.

units.source_text: 当我乘上公共汽车回家时，这个城市的装饰跳入眼帘，使我觉得像是从洞窟中解放出来似的。

en.t: When I got on the bus to go home, the city's decorations leapt into view, making me feel as if I had been released from a cave.

units.source_text: 新车站附近，展现出一条条土色的未经铺设的路。

en.t: Near the new station, one earthen-colored unpaved road after another came into view.

units.source_text: 突击建筑的房屋，一栋栋拔地而起。

en.t: Houses thrown up in hurried construction were rising one after another from the ground.
The new district was disorderly and chaotic.

units.source_text: 在我看来，这是人世间的一种生机。

en.t: To my eyes, this was a kind of vitality in the human world.
